description: Timestamp 1-100 SHA-256 hashes in Bitcoin. Paid per hash with x402: without a payment the tool returns an error whose structuredContent is an x402 PaymentRequired (x402Version 2, exact scheme, USDC on Base). Retry with the same arguments and the signed PaymentPayload in the request's _meta["x402/payment"] (the x402 MCP transport), or, if your client cannot set _meta, in the `payment` argument. The settlement comes back in _meta["x402/payment-response"]. Returns a batch with, per hash, the stamp id, a pending .ots proof (base64: save it now) and its ots_url, plus a receipt signed by us. Invalid input is never charged; retrying with the same payment and arguments returns the same answer without paying twice.

hashes.description: 1-100 SHA-256 hashes, each only once (sha256sum file.pdf, shasum -a 256 file.pdf)

items.description: SHA-256 of the file, 64 hex characters

payment.description: Only if your client cannot send _meta["x402/payment"]: the x402 PaymentPayload, as an object or base64

webhook.description: Optional webhook; deliveries are always signed with our Ed25519 key (see https://stampthisfile.com/llms.txt)

signing_key.description: Optional whsec_<base64> for a Standard Webhooks HMAC (v1) signature

url.description: Public https URL that gets one POST when the batch completes or fails
